title: File:Kareng Ghar, Sivasagar, Assam, India.jpg
author: Neelav Kashyap
description: The image shows the beautiful historical monument Kareng Ghar in Sivasagar, Assam, India made of wood and stone, featuring multiple levels and arched entrances. It is an ancient palace, surrounded by lush greenery. The well-maintained garden includes vibrant orange flowers that add a lovely contrast to the scene. The sky is partly cloudy, allowing sunlight to highlight the details of the structure and the landscape. The photo was taken on September 30, 2017, in the late afternoon.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
